req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the task update endpoint should ignore any changes to the task ID in the request body and only update the task identified by the URL. This ensures data integrity by preventing accidental or malicious changes to task identifiers. The test suite includes a positive test to verify correct behavior, a negative test to ensure errors are handled properly, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid input.

tests.name: test_update_task_ignore_id_change
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a body containing a different ID.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated, ignoring the ID in the body.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a task to update
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Initial Task", "description": "Initial Description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
created_task = response.json()

# Attempt to update the task with a different ID in the body
update_data = {"id": created_task['id'] + 1, "title": "Updated Task", "description": "Updated Description", "completed": True}
response = client.put(f"/tasks/{created_task['id']}", json=update_data)
assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()

# Verify the task was updated correctly
assert updated_task['id'] == created_task['id']
assert updated_task['title'] == "Updated Task"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Updated Description"
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_update_task_invalid_id
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/9999 with valid task data.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to update a non-existent task
update_data = {"title": "Non-existent Task", "description": "This task does not exist", "completed": False}
response = client.put("/tasks/9999", json=update_data)

# Verify the response indicates the task was not found
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()['detail'] == "Task with id 9999 not found"

tests.name: test_update_task_boundary_id
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a body containing the same ID.
expected: The task with ID 1 is updated successfully.
